skills: Up to 4 Physical and Fire hits; the 4th makes the guard boars Spinning Swing.
In combat the guard boars attack on their own with bats, gloves or slingshots for Physical DMG.
On her 4th Basic hit or when Cheer On! is applied, the boars spin their bats for Physical DMG around them (queued if they can't right away).
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Bats a guard boar as a Line Drive that explodes on enemies or walls for Fire DMG; hold for a Fly Ball that explodes where it lands.
Line Drive (or hold for Fly Ball) for massive Fire DMG; triggers a Quick Assist on hit.
After her EX Special, a boar's explosion gives the squad, Bangboo and boars Cheer On!: ATK up from her initial ATK (max 600) for 10s (Line Drive) or 15s (Fly Ball).
Leaping boar launch for massive Fire DMG; triggers a Quick Assist on hit.
Launches every boar for massive Fire DMG. Others recover 10 Energy, and the next Agent in gets 20 more. Triggers a Quick Assist on hit.

core.name: Crimson Mane Guard
core.text: Her Special or EX Special brings a guard boar into battle, which calls two more. They inherit her ATK, Impact and Anomaly Proficiency, attack more often, and get {0}% of the normal Cheer On! buff.

ability.name: Batter Up!
ability.text: The guard boars also inherit her CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG.

mindscapes: Each boar's Spinning Swing gives her 2 Energy (once per 15s per boar).
Her Chain and Ultimate give everyone Cheer On! for 10s.
Cheer On! also gives +10% CRIT DMG.
A cheered squadmate's EX Special hit drops a boar from the sky for 300% of the boar's ATK as Fire DMG, extending Cheer On! by 5s (up to 3 times, max 30s); the boar then does a Spinning Swing.
